# CROSS-TIER PATHS — frontend files that BACKEND tests read off disk.
#
# #5007 (THRU-H). The change classifier may drop the backend jobs for a
# frontend-only candidate. That is only safe because the backend suite is
# assumed not to depend on `frontend/`. It does: twelve backend test files are
# cross-tier parity guards that read client source and assert the client
# consumes what the backend serves.
#
# A frontend-only change that touches ANY path below therefore still runs the
# full suite. Touching none of them is what makes "frontend-only" mean
# "no backend test can see this".
#
# THIS FILE IS NOT MAINTAINED BY HAND ALONE. `backend/tests/test_ci_cross_tier_manifest.py`
# re-derives the set from `backend/tests/` on every run and goes red when a new
# cross-tier read appears that is not listed here. Without that guard this list
# rots into a fail-open the first time somebody adds a parity test — which is
# the whole risk of the classifier, so the guard is the load-bearing half, not
# the list.
#
# Blank lines and `#` comments are ignored. One repo-relative path per line.
#
# A line ending in `/` is a DIRECTORY PREFIX and covers everything beneath it.
# `test_playoff_degraded_contract.py` builds a fixtures directory and then joins
# filenames onto it, so no file-level entry can honestly describe what it reads —
# the directory is the real dependency.

frontend/lib/marketShape.ts
frontend/app/sports/page.tsx
frontend/lib/discover/feedPaging.ts
frontend/lib/tournamentHubs.ts
frontend/components/discover/utils.ts
frontend/app/playoffs/[sport]/page.tsx
frontend/e2e/helpers/sweepFiling.js
frontend/e2e/scripts/file-sweep-findings.js
frontend/lib/discover/feedFreshness.ts
frontend/components/futures/OutcomeRow.tsx
frontend/components/weather/data.ts

# Named as WHOLE-PATH literals rather than component chains (CERT-2566). The
# first cut of the scanner could not see this shape, so these three were missing
# and a change to any of them was classified `frontend` while a backend contract
# depended on it.
frontend/__tests__/components/tournamentReskin.test.tsx
frontend/lib/discoverInteractions.ts
frontend/lib/play/session.ts
frontend/__tests__/fixtures/
